name: Zhejiang Dahua Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Dahua Technology Co., Ltd. provides and operates video-centric IoT solutions. It offers network, high-definition composite video interface (HDCVI), PT, PTZ, thermal, explosion-proof, and anti-corrosion cameras; IP storage products; network and HDCVI recorders; video intercoms; and access control products, including modules, turnstiles, accessories, AI, and time attendance solutions.
